overview.name: Jpmorgan Active Bond ETF
overview.description: The fund seeks to outperform (based on the fund’s total return, gross of fees) the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Bond Index (the benchmark) over a market cycle, typically a 3-5 year time horizon. As a matter of non-fundamental policy, under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds.
